descriptor: Explicit-Seed × Temporal-Wave Orthogonalization, Common-Mode Reconstitution, Split-Panel Concordance, Cross-Provider Temporal Control & Hosted-Inference Nondeterminism Localization

predecessor.key_result: After exact technical completion and corrected Holm adjudication, Gemini valid and null both showed wave_synchrony with Holm-adjusted p=0.0023995200959808036; GPT-OSS showed no corrected primary signal.
predecessor.newly_exposed_confound: In P46, Gemini's explicit API seed was constant within each wave and changed between waves, while the Groq GPT-OSS adapter exposed no corresponding seed control. Therefore Gemini wave identity was perfectly confounded with explicit RNG seed.

scientific_question: Does the P46 Gemini common-mode signal survive when explicit RNG seed and temporal wave are prospectively orthogonalized, or is the apparent wave synchronization primarily a seed-indexed hosted-inference effect?

frozen_surface.aliases: Exact A/B/C/D archive constructions from P44-P46.
frozen_surface.response_contract: Exact P42-P46 provider-native strict contracts; no reselection.
frozen_surface.seed_assignment: Cyclic Latin assignment: for canonical cell index c and wave w in 0..7, Gemini seed index=(c+w) mod 8. Every cell sees every seed exactly once; every wave contains exactly 32 cells at each seed.
frozen_surface.gptoss_seed_status: No explicit seed parameter is supplied by the frozen Groq adapter; GPT-OSS is a contemporaneous temporal-control arm, not an RNG-seed arm.
frozen_surface.cell_order: Within each temporal wave all 256 cells are independently randomized by a frozen deterministic PRNG.
frozen_surface.paired_execution: For each cell, GPT-OSS and Gemini are called consecutively; first arm alternates by frozen wave-position parity.
frozen_surface.panel_partition: P0 iff (vertex_index + alias_index) mod 2 = 0, otherwise P1.

primary_wave_family.tests: Four temporal-wave synchrony tests: 2 model arms × 2 semantic twins.
primary_wave_family.statistic: Variance across temporal waves of cell-centered residual failure means.
primary_wave_family.null: 5000 within-cell temporal-wave permutations preserving each cell's total failures.
primary_wave_family.model_level_gate: Both semantic twins for a model reject after Holm correction.

primary_seed_family.tests: Two Gemini explicit-seed synchrony tests: valid and null.
primary_seed_family.statistic: Variance across the 8 explicit seed labels of cell-centered residual failure means after the Latin seed×wave crossing.
primary_seed_family.multiplicity: Holm FWER=0.05 across the two tests.
primary_seed_family.seed_effect_gate: Both semantic twins reject after Holm correction.

conditional_localization_family.interpretation_gate: Localization is confirmatory only if either Gemini temporal-wave or seed-effect model-level gate passes.
conditional_localization_family.split_panel_seed_concordance: For Gemini valid/null separately, correlate the 8 seed-residual vectors from frozen panels P0 and P1; exact 8! permutation.
conditional_localization_family.split_panel_wave_concordance: For Gemini valid/null separately, correlate the 8 temporal-wave residual vectors from P0 and P1; exact 8! permutation.
conditional_localization_family.cross_arm_temporal_concordance: For valid/null separately, correlate contemporaneous GPT-OSS and Gemini temporal-wave residual vectors; exact 8! permutation.
conditional_localization_family.multiplicity: Holm FWER=0.05 across six localization tests.

secondary_diagnostics: Within-wave normalized position association with cell-centered outcomes.
Per-wave and per-seed technical failure counts.

gates.technical: Every model×semantic×vertex×alias cell requires >=7/8 exact-schema successful calls.
gates.evaluation_artifact: Primary-vs-shadow disagreement >=10% for a technically evaluable model triggers EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT.
gates.seed_reduction: Gemini seed-effect gate passes while Gemini temporal-wave gate fails.
gates.temporal_replication: Gemini temporal-wave gate passes despite balanced explicit seeds.
gates.both: Both Gemini seed-effect and temporal-wave gates pass.
gates.cross_arm_temporal: Both semantic cross-arm temporal correlations survive localization-family Holm correction.

frozen_rules: All P44-P46 cells are replayed; no P46-significant cell enrichment.
Seed×wave orthogonalization was introduced before P47 outcomes specifically because P46's Gemini wave index equaled seed index.
P47 Holm implementation must sort by p-value and pass a zero-call unit test before any model call.
A seed effect is an API-observable hosted-inference effect; it is not a neural-state mechanism.
A residual temporal effect after seed balancing is still compatible with provider/runtime/batching effects.
Contemporaneous cross-arm pairing reduces but does not eliminate external time confounding.
No threshold, panel, statistic, or multiplicity change after outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P47 alone.
